title: Scalar-valued global sections on a small ringed site
statement: Let $(\mathcal C,J)$ be a small site [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] in the common coefficient universe [def-weil-size-convention], let $R$ be a sheaf of commutative rings and let $A$ be a commutative ring in that universe. Write $\Gamma(R)$ for its ring of compatible families and fix a ring homomorphism $s:A\to\Gamma(R)$. On module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] define $\Gamma_{R,A,s}:\operatorname{Mod}_R\to\operatorname{Mod}_A$ by the module of compatible families $x_U\in M(U)$, with $(a x)_U=s(a)_U x_U$ and componentwise action on morphisms. The local action is restriction of scalars along $A\to R(U)$ obtained by evaluating $s$. Define $G_{R,A,s}:D(\operatorname{Mod}_R)\to D(\operatorname{Mod}_A)$ on the unbounded derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] to be the canonical total right derived functor [def-sfb-right-derived-functor] of this additive functor, computed by the existing K-injective resolutions [prop-pur-kinjective-resolutions-exist]. No final object of the site is required.
